from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, BackgroundTasks, HTTPException
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy import select, update

router = APIRouter(prefix="/billing/invoices")

    res = await db.execute(stmt)

        inv.reconciliation_status = "RECONCILED"
        inv.auto_settled = True
        await db.commit()

@router.post("/{invoice_id}/reconcile")

    invoice_id: int,
    background_tasks: BackgroundTasks,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),

diagnosis: The invoice reconciliation endpoint enqueues a background task using the request-scoped database session and the invoice_id path parameter. Inside reconcile_invoice_background, the invoice is loaded and marked RECONCILED without checking whether current_user is the owner of the invoice. An attacker can iterate invoice_ids to force status transitions and settlement flags on invoices belonging to other customers.

corrected_code:
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, BackgroundTasks, HTTPException
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession, async_sessionmaker
from sqlalchemy import select

router = APIRouter(prefix="/billing/invoices")

async def reconcile_invoice_background(invoice_id: int, customer_id: int, session_factory: async_sessionmaker):
    async with session_factory() as db:
        stmt = select(CustomerInvoice).where(
            CustomerInvoice.id == invoice_id,
            CustomerInvoice.customer_id == customer_id
        )
        res = await db.execute(stmt)
        inv = res.scalar_one_or_none()
        if inv:
            inv.reconciliation_status = "RECONCILED"
            inv.auto_settled = True
            await db.commit()

@router.post("/{invoice_id}/reconcile")
async def trigger_invoice_reconciliation(
    invoice_id: int,
    background_tasks: BackgroundTasks,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session),
    session_factory: async_sessionmaker = Depends(get_session_factory)
):
    # Verify invoice ownership before enqueuing background reconciliation
    stmt = select(CustomerInvoice.id).where(
        CustomerInvoice.id == invoice_id,
        CustomerInvoice.customer_id == current_user.customer_id
    )
    res = await db.execute(stmt)
    if not res.scalar_one_or_none():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Invoice not found")

    background_tasks.add_task(
        reconcile_invoice_background,
        invoice_id,
        current_user.customer_id,
        session_factory
    )
    return {"status": "reconciliation_enqueued", "invoice_id": invoice_id}
